decisions.reason: The decision to use the supplied FCC dates in both date sections does not alter the separately confirmed site display name or identifier relationship.
Making the FCC Term and Schedule dates consistent does not change the requirement to sign the subcontractor section.
The source decision governs which FCC dates appear in the document sections; it does not necessarily change the independently defined actual-session wage calculation or its reconciliation policy.
The FCC date-section consistency decision does not modify the confirmed allocated-budget amounts or their reporting basis.
